The '''Zygia system''' was located in the [[Manda sector/Legends|Manda sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Manda Merchant Route/Legends|Manda Merchant Route]] linked it to the [[Holess system/Legends|Holess system]] as well as the [[Thoran system/Legends|Thoran system]]<ref name="TEA" /> in the [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />

The Zygia [[Star system/Legends|system]] shared its name with the [[Zygian Savings and Loan]],<ref name="TCW">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 3: Duel at Shattered Rock]]''</ref> a [[Bank/Legends|bank]] located on the celestial body [[Treylon II]]<ref name="GG7">''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]''</ref> in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]],<ref name="TEA Treylon">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Treylon system/Legends|Treylon system]]</ref> as well as its branch on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the [[Zygian's Banking Concern]].<ref name="GG7" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Zygia system was established in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-14.<ref name="TEA" />
